authority_source: meta authority for a typical publication-gate contradiction inside the R5 MAC corridor
decision: Preserve the four original R5 review artifacts at their exact authority-bound hashes and waive whitespace checking only for those exact paths. Mechanically remove trailing whitespace from the three new correction-01 review Markdown lens files, stage their corrected bytes, and keep diff-check mandatory for every other path.

required_publication_gate.immutable_hash_gate: All four exact hashes must match immediately before commit and after commit.
required_publication_gate.scoped_diff_check: git diff --cached --check over the full staged subject excluding only the four immutable paths must pass. The three correction files are not excluded.
required_publication_gate.correction_review: New correction record remains VALID and CLEAN after mechanical metadata cleanup; product/test subject fingerprint remains unchanged.
required_publication_gate.full_diff_disposition: A full diff-check failure is accepted only when every reported line belongs to the three immutable original Markdown files and their hashes match. Any other reported path blocks.
required_publication_gate.publication: If all prior gates remain green, commit/push the complete 23-path subject as the single R5 fast-forward landing.

review: No new causal cycle is required for whitespace-only edits to review metadata; do not change findings, verdicts, subject fingerprints or product/test bytes.
hard_exclusions: editing any original R5 review artifact
semantic edits to correction review metadata
